candidates.title: What Is STSL on Your Payslip? Study Loan Tax Above $69,528
candidates.description: STSL on your payslip means Study and Training Support Loans: extra tax withheld for HECS-HELP once you earn over $69,528 a year ($1,337 a week) in 2026-27.
candidates.figureSource: HECS/STSL repayment minimumThreshold 69_528 (lib/constants/australian-tax.ts); weekly $1,337 / fortnightly $2,674 as rendered on the page
